plan.artifact_revision_note: Separate method and final data after the failed continued-learning recipe. No retuning or reuse of its final cases.
plan.goal: Test verified calculation-step supervision and protection of teacher-correct token margins in one fixed-size, fully sharded continuation. Generated answers, including original JSON-only prior tasks, must pass fresh frozen gates.

method.reason: Direct-answer training lowered loss but acquired no new correct answers and lost sorting and arithmetic cases. Supervise products and running sums before the final JSON; protect positive teacher token margins on trained replay. This joint hypothesis is not a controlled attribution to either component.

open_source.sealed_means: dataset, parent, optimizer, reference, replay, tokenizer and runtime content hashes are committed to git before the first training step and remain publicly reconstructable from the pinned sources

parent.label: adaptive phase-A three-worker portable checkpoint including Adam

previous_continuation.exclusion: Every committed role is excluded by identity and rendered content, except explicitly selected trained phase-A replay. Public source files are not treated as secret.

plan.public_network: neuroshard-llm-testnet-1 remains unchanged; no genesis, client, PyPI release, public serving promotion or public NEURO issuance is authorized by this plan

quality_gate.selection: Only the predetermined step 384 can be selected. Development may abort but cannot choose another endpoint. Commit its actual checkpoint and development decision before final evaluation.

rewards_and_serving.verified_computation: agreed training reward after signed reserved-window receipts

plan.scope: A joint learning-method experiment on the fixed phase-A 1.7B parent. Both parent and candidate receive identical reasoning prompts for new arithmetic tasks; original prior tasks retain their JSON-only prompts. A parser extracts generated final JSON but never calculates or repairs an answer. This does not establish general assistant quality, independent ownership, economical auditing, model growth or native issuance.
